events.verdict: Okongwu (ATL) plants his foot in Thomas's (BKN) path on the perimeter and Thomas is able to move through the marginal contact.
Okongwu (ATL) deflects the ball away from Thomas (BKN) and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Finney-Smith (BKN) establishes himself in a screening position in Hunter's (ATL) path, absorbing the contact as Hunter attempts to contest the jump shot attempt.
Johnson (ATL) makes clean contact with the loose ball and there is incidental arm contact with Wilson (BKN) as both players pursue the rebound.
Johnson (ATL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Okongwu (ATL) jumps alongside of Thomas (BKN) and absorbs the body contact before cleanly blocking Thomas's shot attempt.
Schr?der (BKN) initiates contact with Okongwu's (ATL) arm that affects his shot attempt near the basket.
Hunter (ATL) moves into Johnson (BKN) and initiates body contact that affects his FOM.
Daniels (ATL) maintains his pivot foot prior to releasing his dribble.

Replay review of the foul called on Johnson (BKN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Johnson moves laterally into Young's (ATL) path and is not established in a legal guarding position when the illegal contact occurs.
Young (ATL) cleanly dislodges the ball from Schr?der (BKN).
Schr?der (BKN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds after the ball deflects off of his leg.
Wilson (BKN) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
Daniels (ATL) gets to the loose ball, which he deflects before losing his balance and coming together with Finney-Smith (BKN). The body contact between the two players is incidental.
Daniels (ATL) briefly wraps his arms around Finney-Smith (BKN) before immediately releasing and the contact does not affect his FOM.
Okongwu (ATL) trails behind Thomas (BKN), jumping alongside of him during his driving shot attempt and the body contact is marginal.
Wilson (BKN) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
Wilson (BKN) and Okongwu (ATL) become tangled as the two players engage during the throw-in and the pass is thrown out of Okongwu's reach.
Thomas (BKN) avoids stepping out of bounds when he gains possession of the ball.
Daniels (ATL) legally contests Thomas's (BKN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Finney-Smith (BKN) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
Johnson (ATL) cleanly steals the throw-in and any contact with Thomas (BKN) is incidental.
